title: CompileResponse
description: The body of a 200 from compile and solve (42).

model.title: ModelContract
model.description: The model contract, or null when the script's language version is not supported.

contractVersion.description: The contract version the producing Core implements, major.minor.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: What produced this: the source, the language, the catalogue, the property backend.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of the source text, as sha256: and 64 hex digits.

languageMajor.description: The language major version the script declared.

catalog.title: VersionedId
catalog.description: The pipe catalogue sizes were drawn from.

atmosphereKPaAbsolute.description: The atmosphere gauge pressures are relative to, kPa absolute (D-26).

project.title: Project
project.description: The project line, absent when the script has none (D-37).

defaultMode.description: The default solve mode, steady, transient or null.

style.title: Style
style.description: Presentation Core carries and never interprets.

tokens.description: The applied style tokens as written.

spacing.description: The spacing value in world units, or null (D-37).

default.title: ResolvedStyle
default.description: The project-level style, applied where a circuit states none.

stroke.description: The stroke colour, #rrggbb, or null for the theme's.

strokeWidth.description: The stroke width in CSS pixels at scale 1, or null for the theme's.

fill.description: The static fill colour, or null for none; the colour scale paints over it while show is active.

corner.description: fillet, round, sharp or null for the theme's.

named.description: The named styles, style name = …, resolved, for an editor to list.

additionalProperties.title: ResolvedStyle
additionalProperties.description: A style with every name resolved (D-104). A null colour or width is the theme's default.

stroke.description: The stroke colour, #rrggbb, or null for the theme's.

strokeWidth.description: The stroke width in CSS pixels at scale 1, or null for the theme's.

fill.description: The static fill colour, or null for none; the colour scale paints over it while show is active.

corner.description: fillet, round, sharp or null for the theme's.

circuits.description: Every circuit, in declaration order; never empty (D-33).

numberIsExplicit.description: Whether the script wrote the number; the printer needs this.

mode.description: The solve mode: steady or transient.

role.description: The resolved role's canonical name, or null for a name the registry does not know (D-35).

parentCircuit.description: The parent circuit, or null when this one stands alone (D-33).

inletAnchorId.description: The parent component this circuit takes flow from.

outletAnchorId.description: The parent component this circuit returns flow to.

solved.description: Whether every component in this circuit has a state (invariant 7).

pressureDatums.description: One pressure datum per hydraulically connected part, not per circuit.

components.description: Every graph component, in graph order.

kind.description: The script keyword for the kind.

mode.description: The kind's canonical mode -- an exchanger's duty, rated or coupled -- absent for a kind without one.

symbolId.description: Which entry in symbols draws it.

origin.description: declared, or inferred:I1, inferred:I2, inferred:I3, inferred:I7 (a pipe a connection line's properties made, D-110).

sourceSpan.title: Span
sourceSpan.description: Where the declaration sits in the source; null for an inferred component.

length.description: The length in UTF-16 code units.

circuit.description: The owning circuit (D-33; the losing side's under D-36).

tag.description: The equipment tag, display metadata only; null when the kind has no code or the component is inferred (D-34).

parameters.description: The design specification, by canonical parameter name, in declaration order of the kind's parameters.

additionalProperties.title: Parameter
additionalProperties.description: One design parameter, with where it came from (D-02).

value.description: The value in Unit, or null under FS2501.

unit.description: The canonical unit, or null for a dimensionless value.

basis.description: Why a sized or default value is what it is; absent for a stated one.

state.title: ComponentState
state.description: The solved operating point, or null when the circuit is unsolved or states are omitted.

flow.title: Quantity
flow.description: Mass flow through the component's first flow group, positive from its first port toward its second.

pIn.description: Pressure at the inlet port, gauge in the canonical unit (D-26).

pOut.title: Quantity
pOut.description: Pressure at the outlet port, gauge in the canonical unit (D-26).

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

dp.title: Quantity
dp.description: Pressure drop inlet to outlet; negative across a pump.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

power.title: Quantity
power.description: Heat into the fluid on the first side, positive when the fluid gains.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

flow2.title: Quantity
flow2.description: Mass flow on an exchanger's second side.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

tIn2.title: Quantity
tIn2.description: Temperature at the second side's inlet.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

tOut2.title: Quantity
tOut2.description: Temperature at the second side's outlet.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

p.title: Quantity
p.description: A node's pressure, gauge in the canonical unit (D-26).

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

solved.description: Solved parameters the solver was asked to find -- a promoted kv, a sized head.

additionalProperties.title: Quantity
additionalProperties.description: A solved value in its canonical unit.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

layers.description: A tank's layers, bottom to top, 1…N.

elevation.description: The layer's top as a fraction of the tank height, 0…1.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

ports.description: Every port, in declaration order; a tank lists only its materialized ports.

connectedTo.description: The component the port is wired to, or null when open.

elevation.description: A tank port's normalized elevation; absent otherwise.

layer.description: The tank layer the port meets; absent otherwise.

symbols.description: The symbol definitions the components reference (D-20, D-24).

items.title: Symbol
items.description: A symbol definition in a normalized box (D-20, D-102).

viewBox.description: The bounding box as [x, y, width, height] in symbol units; what layout reasons on.

primitives.description: What the canvas draws inside the box. Never executable.

items.title: Primitive
items.description: One drawing primitive; the fields a kind does not use are absent.

kind.description: rect, line, circle, polyline or polygon.

points.description: A polyline's or polygon's points, flattened [x0, y0, x1, y1, …].

fill.description: What fills a closed shape: state for the active colour scale's slot (57), stroke for a solid mark in the line colour; absent for an outline.

dashed.description: true for a dashed stroke; absent for a solid one.

portAnchors.description: The default arrangement: each named port's anchor on the box edge and its outward direction.

additionalProperties.title: Anchor
additionalProperties.description: Where a port meets its symbol, and which way a connection leaves it.

at.description: The point on the box edge, [x, y] in symbol units.

direction.description: The outward unit vector a connection leaves along, [dx, dy] with y up (28 A1); rotates with the box. Absent for the wildcard anchor, whose direction the layout chooses.

alternatives.description: Other complete arrangements of the same ports on the same box, by name; the renderer may pick one per instance, with a rotation, to shorten the connections it has to draw. Absent when there is one.

indexedPortAnchors.description: Rules for indexed ports such as a tank's in{n}; absent for a fixed-port symbol.

items.title: IndexedAnchor
items.description: An anchor rule for an indexed port family.

prefix.description: The port name prefix, in or out.

side.description: The box side the family sits on.

direction.description: The outward unit vector every anchor of the family leaves along, [dx, dy].

verticalCoordinate.description: Which port field gives the position along that side.

minIndex.description: The smallest index the rule covers.

maxIndex.description: The largest index the rule covers.

transformClass.description: Which transforms the kind admits (28 A4, D-108): free turns by any quarter, mirrored or not; standing is never turned, only mirrored left-right, up-down or both (every exchanger); upright admits only the left-right mirror (a tank, whose layers are a vertical order); level admits every transform but stands vertical only where nothing level fits (a pump, D-113). A fact about the kind, never a preference.

connections.description: Every adjacency, in the model's connection order, keyed c{n}.

id.description: c{n}, by position in the model's connection list.

port.description: The port name, or null for a node.
The port name, or null for a node.

flow.description: forward, reverse or none: the solved direction relative to how it was written.

state.title: ConnectionState
state.description: The solved flow along it, or null when unsolved.

flow.title: Quantity
flow.description: The mass flow in the written direction.

value.description: The value in , or null under FS2501.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: The layout hints, serialized from 25's contract field for field.

order.description: Depth-first order from each pressure datum.

thermalStages.description: The heat-progression bands, left to right.

role.description: source, conversion, storage, consumer or neutral.

placementAnchorId.description: The component it is drawn beside.

actuationTargetId.description: What it drives, or null for an instrument.

navigationOrder.description: Its position in the tab order.

distributionGroups.description: Subcircuits sharing one parent, in declaration order.

margin.description: The clearance every component keeps from every other, world units (D-103); the spacing directive or 0.5.

extent.description: The bounds of the whole drawing as [x, y, width, height], world units, outer boxes and routes included.

placements.description: Where every component sits, in Order then the non-flow elements.

items.title: Placement
items.description: One component's place in the drawing (D-103). World units: a pump is 1×1, y grows upward and a box's y is its bottom edge (28 A1).

inner.description: The symbol's box as placed, [x, y, width, height]; the renderer draws the strokes inside it.

outer.description: The inner box grown by the margin; no other component's inner box enters it.

rotation.description: The quarter turn applied, clockwise degrees: 0, 90, 180 or 270.

mirrored.description: Whether the symbol is mirrored left-to-right before the turn.

arrangement.description: default or one of the symbol's alternative arrangements (D-102).

anchors.description: Every port's anchor in world coordinates with its outward direction; a node's ports are #0, #1, …

source.description: computed; pinned is reserved for a placement the script states.

style.title: ResolvedStyle
style.description: The resolved style: the script's named or anonymous style (D-104); absent when the theme's defaults apply throughout.

stroke.description: The stroke colour, #rrggbb, or null for the theme's.

strokeWidth.description: The stroke width in CSS pixels at scale 1, or null for the theme's.

fill.description: The static fill colour, or null for none; the colour scale paints over it while show is active.

corner.description: fillet, round, sharp or null for the theme's.

scale.description: Where the component's representative value sits on the active colour scale, 0 to 1; null when not computed. The same as Scales[visualization.active].At.

scales.description: The component's position on every available scale, keyed by property (D-117): the switcher needs no request.

additionalProperties.title: ScalePosition
additionalProperties.description: An element's place on one colour scale, each 0 to 1 or null where the element has no such value (57 invariant 5: neutral, never the low end).

at.description: The representative value: a node's own, a component's outlet (D-30).

from.description: Where a gradient starts: a component's inlet, a route's first end.

to.description: Where it ends: a component's outlet, a route's last end.

routes.description: Every connection's path, in connection order, then the instruments' signal lines.

id.description: c{n} for a connection; {instrument}:measures or {controller}:actuates for a signal line.

layer.description: The draw order (28 C16): supply in front, return behind it, signal behind everything. A pipe is supply until the flow from a heat source has passed a losing side.

points.description: The orthogonal polyline, flattened [x0, y0, x1, y1, …]; the first and last points are the anchors.

hops.description: Where this route passes behind another it crosses, flattened [x0, y0, …] in world units; the renderer breaks this route around each so the one in front runs through (28 C16).

style.title: ResolvedStyle
style.description: The resolved style, from the component the route leaves; absent when the theme's defaults apply throughout.

stroke.description: The stroke colour, #rrggbb, or null for the theme's.

strokeWidth.description: The stroke width in CSS pixels at scale 1, or null for the theme's.

fill.description: The static fill colour, or null for none; the colour scale paints over it while show is active.

corner.description: fillet, round, sharp or null for the theme's.

scaleFrom.description: The scale position at the start, for a gradient; null when not computed. The same as Scales[visualization.active].From.

scaleTo.description: The scale position at the end.

scales.description: The route's ends on every available scale, keyed by property (D-117); At is unused for a route.

active.description: The property the colour scale follows.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: The scale for Active. The same as Scales[Active].

unit.description: The unit the domain is in.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: The range mapped to the scale's ends, or null before anything is solved.

min.description: The low end, in the scale's unit.

max.description: The high end, in the scale's unit.

nice.description: Whether the ends were rounded outward to legend ticks.

degenerate.description: Whether every element has the same value.

scales.description: A scale per available property (D-117), each with its own domain, so switching needs no recompile (57 invariant 6).

unit.description: The unit the domain is in.

domain.description: The range mapped to the scale's ends, or null before anything is solved.

degenerate.description: Whether every element has the same value.

value.description: The value in , or null when the binding is deferred to the solve.

unit.description: The canonical unit, or null when dimensionless or deferred.

dimension.description: The dimension's name, so the editor can filter completion by it (52); null for a dimensionless, an unnamed or a deferred binding.

siUnit.description: For an unnamed dimension, the SI spelling the value carries, shown dimmed by completion; otherwise null.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic the pipeline produced, ordered by severity then offset (44).

range.title: Range
range.description: Where, or null when it is about no source text.

length.description: The length in UTF-16 code units.

component.description: The component it is about, or null.

length.description: The length in UTF-16 code units.
The length in UTF-16 code units.

solve.title: Solve
solve.description: What the solve did, or null when nothing was solved.

iterations.description: Newton iterations on the last pass.

residualNorm.description: The scaled residual norm at the end.

elapsedMs.description: Wall time, or null when the caller did not time it.

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics, only when Model is null; absent otherwise.

sizeMs.description: Lowering with sizing applied, before the solve; zero when nothing was lowered.

solveMs.description: The outer loop; zero when nothing was solved.

totalMs.description: Request receipt to the response being built, layout and serialization included.
